title: Indian-Style Keto Fish Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy keto dish made with marinated fish, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. Serve with a side of cauliflower rice or a simple green salad.

ingredients.name: Yellow Indian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Indian grocery stores or online

instructions: Thread fish pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together turmeric, Indian spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lime juice.
